newsitem.title: USA: IMF approves release of $75 mln for Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: IMF approves release of $75 mln for Pakistan.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has approved the release of some $75 million to Pakistan under an existing stand-by loan accord, an IMF spokesman said on Wednesday.
The approval of the release of the loan tranche came on Monday after the IMF's board decided that Pakistan's economic reform program remains on track.
The IMF resumed lending to Pakistan last month under an expanded and extended stand-by loan pact worth about $830 million.
